body:
Adds `research/intent-twin`: a two-goal sequential goal-inference test tuned against a simulated human. It gives the exact real error `1/(1+r^h)`, the optimism of a too-rational twin, the cost of a too-irrational one, the population error floor, and the effect of calibrating from finite real cues. It builds on the CAIRO and HIRO directions and reproduces no specific paper. Pure Python, 6 tests pass, results in `experiments/results.txt`. README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added, and `python site/build.py` prints ok.
